customer: Caller from Dunmore, a veteran selling his pickup, was annoyed about paying insurance on a truck he's handing over and wanted to know if he could cancel the policy now, before the home pickup.
agent: Customer asked whether he could cancel insurance on his pickup ahead of the home pickup. Explained per 'When to cancel your insurance' that the truck needs to stay insured until the sale is complete and it's in our hands, including on pickup day, and that he should cancel or remove it from his policy only after signing the paperwork. Suggested he ask his insurer about a refund for the unused part of his premium. Also reminded him to remove toll tags, garage codes and paired phones before handing the truck over.
